pkgmetadata.longdescription: DeepJIT is a header-only C++20 JIT runtime for NVIDIA CUDA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs. It gives C++/Python extension authors a shared interface for compiling kernel source at runtime, caching the resulting binaries, loading them onto the device, and launching them with backend-specific options. It is meant to be embedded into a consuming extension's include path rather than used standalone.
